title: Hlavný Článok (Grid Span)
instructions:
Goal:

We have created a grid with 3 columns. So far, each article is trapped in its own single cell. However, we want the main article with the photo to look 'Featured' and take up more space.

  • Find the class for the main article (.featured).
  • Use the CSS Grid property for columns and command it to stretch across two columns.
  • To make the article truly huge, command it to stretch across two rows as well.

checks.message: Command the element to stretch across multiple columns (e.g. span 2 or 1 / 3).
checks.studentHint: The main article spans across 2 columns.

checks.message: Command the element to take up space downwards into the next row as well.
checks.studentHint: The main article spans down across 2 rows.
